title: Protocol to study cell death using TUNEL assay in Drosophila imaginal discs
protocol: Dissect eye-antennal imaginal discs along with the brain lobes from wandering third instar larvae.
Transfer dissected tissue into cold 1× Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS).
Fix tissue in freshly prepared 4% Paraformaldehyde diluted in 1× PBS for 20 min at room temperature.
Wash the tissue in 1× PBS once.
Wash the tissue in PBST (1×PBS+0.2% Triton-X-100) three times for 10 min each.
Prepare primary antibody (Rat anti-Elav) at a 1:100 dilution in 10% Normal Donkey Serum (NDS) in 1XPBST solution.
Incubate the tissue in primary antibody overnight (∼8–16 h) at 4°C.
Wash the tissue in 1× PBST, thrice for 10 min each.
Prepare secondary antibody (anti-Rat Cy5) at a dilution of 1:300 in 1× PBST-NDS.
Incubate the tissue in a secondary antibody for 2 h in the dark at RT.
Wash the tissue in 1× PBST thrice for 10 min each.
Prepare freshly 495 μL of 100 mM Sodium Citrate stock solution + 5 μL of 10% Triton X-100.
Incubate the tissue in this solution for 30 min in the dark at 65°C.
Wash the tissue in 1× PBST thrice for 10 min each.
Incubate the tissue in ∼30 μL of TUNEL-Dilution Buffer (Roche) for 10 min in the dark at RT.
Incubate the tissue in a TUNEL labeling solution for 2 h at 37°C.
Wash the tissue in 1× PBST, thrice for 10 min each.
Transfer the tissue onto a clean glass slide.
Carefully remove the brain lobes from the tissue.
Detach the eye-antennal imaginal discs from the mouth hooks.
Arrange the eye-antennal discs on the slide.
Remove excess PBST from the arranged discs.
Mount the prepared tissue in Vectashield mounting medium.
Store the slides in a slide holder at -20°C.
TUNEL label will be visible in the Cy3 channel if you use this In Situ Cell Death Detection, TMR red Kit.
Save all images in the original format and other appropriate formats for later analysis.
Use .tif images for quantification of TUNEL positive nuclei.
Perform statistical analysis using MS Excel or GraphPad Prism.
Plot a graph based on the analysis.
